instructions_to_main_agent: Theme: Warm Editorial Parchment. Import '@fontsource-variable/lora' and '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans' in frontend/src/index.css.
Do NOT use generic cold blues or tech purples. Use rich Terracotta (#9A3412), Forest Green (#2B533E), and warm Parchment (#FAF7F2).

Pincode Serviceability: Seed supported pincodes across major Indian hubs (e.g. 560001 Bangalore Central, 560034 Koramangala, 560038 Indiranagar, 110001 Delhi Connaught Place, 400001 Mumbai Fort, 400050 Bandra, 500081 HITEC City Hyderabad, 411001 Pune Camp) and provide clean validation feedback.
Subscription Plan: Standardized quarterly plan at ₹1,499 for 3 months (4 books/month = 12 books total). Payment must be mockable with Instant Confirmation.

WhatsApp Notification System: Implement real-time simulation toast and a dedicated notification log showing the 4 lifecycle messages (Order Placed, Out for Delivery, Day 27 Return Reminder, Pickup Complete).
Always include testids as outlined in the `test_attributes` map so all interactive flows are verified.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop: Use asymmetrical editorial layouts, distinct font pairings, and high-contrast readable surfaces.
Never apply universal transitions like transition: all. Target specific properties (opacity, transform, background-color).
Never center align the entire app container or rely on generic centered hero layouts.
Use generous padding (p-6 to p-12) and avoid cramped text-to-border containers.
Use Sonner for toasts placed at bottom-right.
